info.name: BloxFi API
info.description:
E2E testing for BloxFi API. Partner routes: `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1`.

**Auth (default):** `Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}` — 32 alphanumeric chars (DB-backed API key). **JWT:** same header with user JWT (`sub`/`userId` in payload) for user-scoped calls.

**Idempotent POSTs:** Pre-request Scripts generate a fresh UUID into `requestId`; the `requestId` header must match the body where required.

**Create User:** `201` on first create, `200` when the same `requestId` + same body is replayed — test script saves `userId` for both. **Onramp:** user `businessInfo.email` is required (Palremit `POST /v1/provisioned-accounts`).

**Fee previews:** `GET …/onramps/rates` and `GET …/offramps/rates` accept optional quote inputs and return a **`quote`** object (`sendGross`, `receiveGross`, `receiveNet`, **`transferFee`**). Offramp also returns **`sendNet`** (provider fee deducted from send crypto). Onramp deducts the provider fee from receive; offramp deducts from send.

**Webhooks:** `POST /api/v1/webhooks` — no Bearer auth. Set **`webhookSecret`** = server `WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Palremit Orchestrator sends **`deposit.credited`** / **`withdrawal.*`** (see Webhooks folder). Scripts set `X-Liquidity-Event-Id` and `X-Webhook-Signature`.

**Readiness:** `GET /ready` (root, not under `/api/v1`) — DB + Redis; no auth.

**Palremit:** After **Create Onramp**, set collection variable **`palremitProvisionedAccountId`** from DB `Onramp.providerRefs.palremitOrchestrator.provisionedAccountId` (not returned in API). Then run **Webhook: deposit.credited (onramp fiat)** → **Get Onramp** to trigger crypto payout.

**Offramp fiat payout:** Run **Payout corridors** → **Create Account (offramp)** (`corridor` + `destination`) → **Create Offramp**. After **`deposit.credited`**, server advances payout; use **Retry Fiat Payout** if needed. After **COMPLETED**, platform fee settles automatically; simulate confirmation with **withdrawal.successful (offramp platform fee)**.

**E2E flow:** Readiness → Health → Create User → … → Limits (see `postman/README.md`). Variables auto-saved: `userId`, `fileId`, `accountId`, `walletId`, `onrampId`, `onrampTxnRef`, `offrampId`, `offrampTxnRef`, `highValueRequestId`.

**Body (camelCase):** `asset`, `bankCode`, `accountNumber`; optional `destinationType` `bank_account`. item.name: Offramps
item.description: Crypto → fiat (Palremit). Fiat withdrawal uses account **`providerPayout`**. Palremit **`POST /v1/withdrawals`**: `destination_type` = `local_bank` | `wire`, top-level **`country`**. USD offramps need **`metadata.isSelfTransfer`** (and **`destination.purposeOfPayment`**). **`destination.amount`** is computed server-side (send crypto minus Palremit **`transferFee`** × rate). Response **`fees.transferFee`** itemizes the provider fee in its own currency (e.g. USDC). Platform fee settles in USDC after **COMPLETED**.

request.description: **200:** rate fields + limits. Optional **`amount`**, **`country`**, **`destinationType`** (and **`beneficiaryType`**) → **`quote`** with **`sendNet`** (send after provider fee), **`receiveNet`**, **`transferFee`** (fee in provider currency, e.g. USDC). Offramp deducts provider fee from **send** crypto. See **Get Offramp Rates (with fee preview)**.
Same as NGN rates example; **`toCurrency`** = **USD** for USDT→USD. Enable optional query params from **Get Offramp Rates** for fee preview.

**Fee preview** for crypto → fiat (NGN example). **`amount`** = crypto sent; corridor keys must match the payout account. **200** includes **`quote`**: `sendNet` = send minus provider fee (in send currency); `receiveNet` = net fiat delivered; **`transferFee`** surfaced in provider currency (e.g. USDC), not converted to payout fiat. Use **`{{payoutCorridor*}}`** vars for USD/international corridors.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description:
`POST /api/v1/webhooks` — no Bearer auth. **`webhookSecret`** = server `WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Palremit Orchestrator uses **`event_id`**, **`event_type`**, **`occurred_at`**, **`data`**; scripts set **`X-Liquidity-Event-Id`** (new UUID per send, dedupe) and sign the **exact** JSON string with HMAC-SHA256 → **`X-Webhook-Signature`**.

**Onramp:** **Create Onramp** → set **`palremitProvisionedAccountId`** from DB → **deposit.credited (onramp fiat)** → **Get Onramp**. **Offramp:** **Create Offramp** → same prov id + **deposit.credited (offramp crypto)** (webhook advances crypto + attempts fiat). If fiat did not start, **Retry Fiat Payout**. After offramp **COMPLETED**, simulate **withdrawal.successful (offramp platform fee)** to confirm USDC platform-fee settlement (`client_reference` = `{offrampTxnRef}-FEE`). **Get Offramp** is read-only.

exec: if (!secret) { console.warn('Set collection variable webhookSecret to WEBHOOK_SECRET'); }

request.description: Orchestrator **`deposit.credited`** for offramp: **`CRYPTO_DEPOSIT`**, asset/network must match **Create Offramp** `source`. Webhook sets **`CRYPTO_CONFIRMED`** and attempts fiat payout. Use **Retry Fiat Payout** if payout did not start; **Get Offramp** only reads state.
After onramp reaches **`CRYPTO_PENDING`** and Palremit completes payout. If DB has **`palremitWithdrawalId`**, it must match **`withdrawal.id`** or this is ignored.

Simulates Palremit confirming USDC platform-fee settlement after offramp **COMPLETED**. Uses **`client_reference`** = `{offrampTxnRef}-FEE`. Updates **`fees.platformFee.settlement`** to **completed** with **`transactionHash`** from **`settlement_reference`**.
